thread:
Maya CSM: Quick ask for LighthouseRX — they're launching a pilot in APAC and EU next week. Seeing 429s on heavy webhook traffic from eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. Can we do a temporary rate-limit increase + add their webhook destination IPs to an allowlist?
Ravi Kumar: What rate window and how big is the bump?
Maya CSM: Customer requested +3x burst for 48h starting 2026-05-10T00:00Z and a soft qps increase on their account. They also supplied destination IPs: 198.51.100.24 and 198.51.100.25 (they control receiving endpoints).
Helena Ortiz: On hosted tier we can apply a per-account rate-window override (ephemeral). Need a support ticket with account id, CIDR (if any), start/end times, and a reason. Any renewal/risks?
Maya CSM: Renewal convo in 3 weeks — flagged as medium risk if pilot fails. Want close monitoring + a 24h check-in post-go-live.
Sam Liu: I'll prep the ticket. Need: account: lighthouse-prod, req: +300% burst for 48h, start: 2026-05-10T00:00Z, end: 2026-05-12T00:00Z, allowlist: [198.51.100.24, 198.51.100.25], regions: eu-west-1, ap-south-1. Anything else?
Ravi Kumar: Add alerting: p99 errors > 1% or p95 latency > 180ms for those regions. Tag eng-sre and eng-infra. Also add auto-revoke at end time and 6h pre-expiry notif to CSM.
Helena Ortiz: Product ask captured: customer wants a hosted persistent egress IP option. Added note to product backlog and linked ticket.
Sam Liu: Created TKT-4521: "LighthouseRX temporary RL bump + destination allowlist" -> assigned eng-infra. Link: https://support.redwood/TKT-4521
InfraBot: TKT-4521 -> status: open -> assignees: eng-infra, eng-sre. Scheduled prep window 2026-05-09T22:00Z. Auto-revoke configured for 2026-05-12T00:10Z.
Maya CSM: Scheduled 2026-05-10T08:00Z quick sync with customer for first-day signals. Will run success check at 24h. Please ping me on regressions.
Ravi Kumar: Noted. I'll add a short rollback playbook: if p99>1% or sustained 429s -> remove RL override and fallback to global route; notify CSM and trigger postmortem if repeated.
Maya CSM: Thanks team. Recording feedback: persistent-hosted-egress requested, regional failover docs would help.
